text:
maria gonzalez: Taking over oncall for tonight. We have a small prod rollout scheduled — optimizer-config + autoscaler tweak. Canary at 5% then 25% -> full if green. Planned deploy time 23:00 UTC (16:00 PT?) wait, meant 23:00 UTC = 16:00 PDT — sorry, correct time is 23:00 UTC (16:00 PDT). Freeze window: 22:00-02:00 PDT. Expected: short latency blips during cache warmup and a possible transient increase in DB read QPS. I'll be primary watcher until 00:00 PDT, then hand off to Tony.

ton y chen: ack. can you add explicit watchers for errors and latency? i'll take the late-night slot after 00:00.

samir patel: quick smoke checks i'll run right before canary:
```
# smoke generation
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"smoke","max_tokens":5}'
# k8s checks
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide
kubectl -n prod logs deployment/inference --tail=50
```
also check /health and /metrics for 5xx and token-latency distributions.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: optimizer-config@v1.3.2 -> prod
Canary 5% at 1995071400 (23:00 UTC), auto-promote to 25% after 10m if no regressions.

alice ng: i'll watch errors & SLOs (PD on). will monitor p95/p50 and error-rate panel. ping me if anything spikes.

benjamin lee: i'll watch autoscaler behavior and latency. if p50 latency +100ms for 3 consecutive minutes, i'll start manual rollback unless rollback plan says otherwise.

maria gonzalez: notable risk: CACHE_PREFIX change in the new config — could cause cache misses and higher DB reads for ~10–20m. If you see DB read QPS > 2x baseline or cache hit rate drop > 30%, rollback.

tony chen: noted. where's the rollback command in case deploy rotates bad pods? please include exact commands.

maria gonzalez: rollback steps:
1) Abort promotion: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference --replicas=0` (if extreme)
2) Preferred: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=$(kubectl -n prod rollout history deployment/inference | tail -n +2 | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')`
3) Revert config in k8s secret: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/inference CACHE_PREFIX=old_prefix`
Also open the post-deploy note in #incidents if errors > 3% or rollback performed.

samir patel: I'll run smoke after canary deploy and post results here (curl + sample responses). If sample outputs look garbled, fail fast.

alice ng: added watchers to the grafana alert: err-rate (5xx) >0.5% for 3m and latency p50 >100ms regression for 3m. alerts go to eng-oncall channel + PD.

benjamin lee: i'll have a dashboard tab open on autoscaler events and node CPU. i'll manual-scale if necessary and call rollback if scaling doesn't catch up within 5m.

maria gonzalez: FYI: no schema changes, no db migrations. Deploys are config-only. TTL for KV caches will be 60s temporarily to warm caches faster.

tony chen: i'll take the handoff at 00:00 PDT. maria, please DM pager handover when you leave. i'll be primary from 00:00-08:00 PDT.

maria gonzalez: pinned a concise runbook + playbook here: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollouts/nightly-quick-runbook
Also tagging the repo diff: https://git.redwood/infra/optimizer/commit/abc123

deploy-bot: Canary started: optimizer-config@v1.3.2 -> prod (5%)

samir patel: canary smoke: generation OK, 0 5xx in 2m, p95 latency +30ms. posting raw curl output: `{"id":"abc","text":"smoke"}`

alice ng: watching — panels look fine, cache hit rate dropped 12% (expected), DB QPS +18% (within threshold).

benjamin lee: autoscaler scaled from 4->6 pods, cpu stable.

maria gonzalez: promoting to 25% in 10m if no regressions. leaving now for short break, handing to Tony for the remainder. ping me if anything odd.

tony chen: taking handoff. I'll update last_message_ts when I confirm full-promote or rollback. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
